critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and localized: StaffAssignSelect.jsx now sets type='button' on qs-submit/qs-use-existing/Annulla/Indietro and on list buttons (staff-opt-*). This prevents the inner click from being interpreted as a submit by any outer <form>.

EntityDialog in crm.jsx now ignores pointer interactions that originate from Radix popper content wrappers (onInteractOutside preventDefault when target.closest('[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]')), which correctly keeps the parent Dialog open while the Popover handles its own close. Scoped and side-effect free for existing dialogs since no popper-sourced events were used to close them intentionally.
Both changes are low risk and consistent across Team dialog and Pipeline/Attenzione contexts.

rca of the issue: Previous behavior: clicking qs-submit inside EntityDialog triggered an implicit form submission (default type='submit') and/or an outside-interaction event on the parent Radix Dialog, which closed the whole Dialog before submitQuick could fire. Fix: (1) make all buttons inside StaffAssignSelect explicit type='button' so they never act as form submitters; (2) in EntityDialog's DialogContent, onInteractOutside preventDefault when the originating target is inside a Radix popper content wrapper, so Popover interactions do not dismiss the parent Dialog. Verified via network inspector that POST /api/staff/quick-add now fires (200) and the parent [role='dialog'] remains open (count stays at 1 after submit).
